item.para: ATC datalink communications (ADS-C, CPDLC, DCL, OCL, and D-ATIS) are not available.
Associated ATC datalink Required Communication / Surveillance Performance (RCP / Initial Continental Performance for CPDLC and RSP for ADS-C) capabilities are lost.
For more information on aircraft capability on ATC datalink communication, .
As an alternate procedure, ATC may permit the use of voice communication on alternate route that does not require FANS A aircraft capability.
ATC permits the use of the voice communication for operations that require FANS B aircraft capability.
For aircraft with the 4D Operations capability, 4D Operations are not permitted.
